diagnosis: PhoneDeviceRenameView allows updating the friendly label and delivery preference of a 2FA phone device. The view sets queryset = PhoneDevice.objects.all() and looks up the object solely by primary key in get_object() without filtering by request.user. An authenticated user can tamper with the labels and configurations of 2FA devices belonging to any account across the system.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from two_factor.plugins.phonenumber.models import PhoneDevice
from .serializers import PhoneDeviceLabelSerializer

class PhoneDeviceRenameView(generics.UpdateAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = PhoneDeviceLabelSerializer
    queryset = PhoneDevice.objects.all()

    def get_object(self):
        # Scope lookup to devices owned by the authenticated user
        device_id = self.kwargs.get("pk")
        return generics.get_object_or_404(self.queryset.filter(user=self.request.user), pk=device_id)
